name: scenario_Services_a_script_service_runs_the_script_it_names
description: A script service added by name runs that script: a service whose script writes a surface slot, and the slot holding what it wrote. The live-data process names jsondemo.mls, which needs the internet; a script of the scenario's own proves the same path offline.

steps.name: stage-the-script
steps.description: A service that writes fader7 every 20 ms, so the slot shows it ran.

steps.name: add-the-service
steps.description: Added under Services and named by its script, as the live-data process does.

steps.name: running
steps.description: Frames pass, the script compiles and its tick writes the slot.
